task: Build the 'Viet Kudos' compose form: recipient search dropdown, Danh hieu (title) field, minimal rich text editor (bold/italic/strikethrough/list/link/quote + @mention, 1000 char cap), up to 5 hashtags, up to 5 image uploads, an anonymous toggle (reveals a required nickname field), a static 'Tieu chuan cong dong' link, and Huy/Gui buttons. Submit creates a new KudosPost that appears at the top of the All Kudos list built in F006.
acceptanceCriteria: clicking the 'Ghi nhan' composer pill on /kudos opens the Viet Kudos dialog (role=dialog, aria-modal)
submitting with recipient/title/content/hashtag all empty shows inline errors per field and does not close the dialog or call onSubmit
a valid submit builds a KudosPost (new id, formatted timestamp, hearts:0, imageCount from selected files) and prepends it to the All Kudos feed without a page refresh
checking 'Gui an danh' reveals a required Nickname field; submitting anonymous replaces sender with {name: nickname, department: '', stars: 0}
hashtag input auto-prefixes '#', dedupes case-insensitively, and caps at 5; image upload caps at 5 and only persists imageCount (no real upload/storage)
rich text content stays a plain string end to end (KudosPost.content) - no HTML persisted or rendered
cancel button discards the draft and closes without calling onSubmit
Escape / outside-click closes the dialog (via the shared use-dismissable-menu hook)
existing F006 KudosCard/KudosBanner/KudosBoard tests and behavior are unchanged (title/composerTriggerProps are additive-optional)
new kudos.compose i18n namespace exists in both vi.ts and en.ts with identical key sets (parity test passes)
vitest suite passes (existing + new tests); tsc --noEmit passes; npm run build passes; eslint clean on new/modified files
blastRadius: F006's KudosPost/KudosPerson contract - only additive fields (title?) allowed, no breaking changes
F006's kudos-card.test.tsx / kudos-banner.test.tsx - must remain green with the new optional props
lib/i18n dictionary parity test (adding kudos.compose to both files)
app/kudos/page.tsx composition - KudosBanner + KudosBoard now sit inside the new KudosPageClient wrapper
contracts: KudosPost.title is optional (title?: string) - existing title-less posts must keep rendering unchanged
KudosBanner.composerTriggerProps is optional - omitted means the pill stays inert (F006 default)
getDistinctRecipients(posts, currentUser) excludes currentUser by name, dedupes by name, first-seen order, no mutation
Dictionary type = typeof vi (lib/i18n/dictionary.ts) - new kudos.compose namespace must satisfy this in en.ts
No backend/persistence exists - submitted posts are session-scoped client state only (lost on refresh)
